name: forge-agent
description: Forge — AI coding agent CLI with harness (blocking Stop, /goal, ULW), production reliability (Retry-After, abortable streams, JSON repair, doom-loop, error-streak, apply_patch, overflow recovery, session lock/auto-resume, forge run --continue, lock-safe prune/delete, shell-safe /diff, metrics.jsonl, OAuth refresh, structured doctor --json), and expert UX (/retry, /last, /files, /pin, resume-by-title, /share, /stats, forge news, forge tips)

scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run smoke
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js --version && (node dist/cli.js doctor --json >/dev/null || true) && node dist/cli.js completion bash >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js models --json >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js stats --json >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js news >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js prune-tool-output --json >/dev/null && node dist/cli.js prune-metrics --json >/dev/null
